scope: Sending through Thunderbird works with work accounts that need a sign-in, and Thunderbird closes with Voice Companion.

topics.title: Sign in to send
details: A work account may ask you to sign in again before you can send.
Voice Companion now opens that sign-in page in its own browser, so you can finish it.
After you sign in, Thunderbird sends the message. Check the Sent folder before you send it again.

topics.title: Thunderbird closes with Voice Companion
details: Did Voice Companion open Thunderbird? Then it closes when you close Voice Companion.
If you opened Thunderbird yourself, it stays open.
If a message is still being written in Thunderbird, Thunderbird stays open.

topics.title: Sending through Thunderbird
details: If sending is slow, you hear Still sending every 15 seconds. Press Escape to stop waiting.
If you stop waiting, Thunderbird may still send it. Check the Sent folder before you send it again.
If sending fails, you hear why, for example that the mail server did not answer.
A message that fails is saved in Drafts, and no Thunderbird window is left open.
